title: Weekly Streaming Suggestions — Oct 2, 2026

  • One of Them Days (Hulu) — IMDb Not verified · RT 94% — Roommates Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) race the clock after Alyssa's boyfriend blows their rent money; added Sep 30. RT release

title: Weekly Wine Report — Oct 2, 2026
html:
What's Popular Now

  • Aubert dominates California Pinot — Wine Spectator's California Pinot Noir report (Sep 30, 750+ wines) is topped by Aubert, with two Sonoma Coast bottlings at 96–97 points. source
  • Boisset buys Artesa (Carneros) — Jean-Charles Boisset acquired Artesa's brand and 350-acre estate from Raventós Codorníu (Sep 23); price undisclosed. Decanter also covered it Sep 24. source

  • Splurge: Aubert Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast CIX 2024 — 97 pts Wine Spectator, $125. Also Domaine de la Côte Pinot Noir Sta. Rita Hills La Côte 2024 — 96 pts WS, $399/1.5L. source

  • Aubert Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast CIX 2024 — 97 pts Wine Spectator (James Molesworth), $125; top wine of the Sep 30 California Pinot Noir report. source
  • Aubert Pinot Noir Sonoma Coast UV Vineyard 2024 — 96 pts Wine Spectator, $105. source
